content:
Krataa yi firi Paulo a Onyankopɔn ayi no sɛ Kristo Yesu ɔsomafoɔ no ne Timoteo a ɔyɛ yɛn nuanom no mu baako nkyɛn,
    
    Mede saa krataa yi rekɔma Onyankopɔn asafo a ɛwɔ Korinto ne ahotefoɔ a wɔwɔ Akaiaman mu no nyinaa:

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:1-3

content: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Onyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:1-3

content: Momma yɛnna Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Agya no a ɔyɛ mmɔborɔhunu Agya na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn a awerɛkyekyerɛ nyinaa firi no no ase.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:1-3

content: Ɔkyekyere yɛn werɛ wɔ yɛn amaneɛ nyinaa mu na yɛnam awerɛkyekyerɛ a yɛn ankasa anya afiri Onyankopɔn nkyɛn no so atumi akyekyere afoforɔ a wɔwɔ amaneɛ ahodoɔ mu no werɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Sɛdeɛ yɛahunu amane wɔ Kristo mu no, saa ara nso na yɛnya Kristo awerɛkyekyerɛ a ɛdɔɔso no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Mo awerɛkyekyerɛ ne mo nkwagyeɛ enti yɛhunu amane. Ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ Kristo kyekye yɛn werɛ a, yɛn nso yɛnam so bɛtumi akyekye mo werɛ. Ɛno bɛma mo anya ntoboaseɛ ahunu amane sɛ yɛn nso.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Enti, gyidie a yɛwɔ wɔ mo mu no nhinhim. Yɛnim sɛ, sɛdeɛ mo ne yɛn hunu amane no, saa ara nso na awerɛkyekyerɛ a yɛnya no, monya bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Anuanom, yɛpɛ sɛ yɛtwe mo adwene ba ɔhaw a ɛtoo yɛn wɔ Asia mantam mu no so. Amane a yɛfaa mu no so, na na emu yɛ duru enti yɛn asetena mu anidasoɔ nyinaa yeraeɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Nokorɛm yɛgye too mu sɛ yɛrebɛwu. Saa asɛm yi siiɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a yɛremfa yɛn ho nto yɛn ankasa so, na mmom, yɛde yɛn ho bɛto Onyankopɔn a ɔma awufoɔ sɔre no so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Wayi yɛn afiri saa owuo amanehunu yi mu na ɔbɛkɔ so agye yɛn. Ɔno na yɛde yɛn ani ato no so sɛ, sɛ mokɔ so bɔ mpaeɛ ma yɛn a,

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: ɔbɛgye yɛn bio. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, ɔbɛbua mpaeɛ dodoɔ biara a mobɔ ma yɛn no, na Onyankopɔn bɛhyira yɛn, na dodoɔ no ara ama wɔn nne so de ada no ase ama yɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Yɛhoahoa yɛn ho sɛ yɛn ahonim mmu yɛn fɔ, yɛatena ase nokorɛdie mu, ne titire ne ɛberɛ a yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no. Ɛnyɛ ewiase nyansa na ɛkyerɛ yɛn kwan. Mmom, yɛn akwankyerɛ firi Onyankopɔn adom no mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Nsɛm a mobɛtumi akenkan, ate aseɛ nko na yɛtwerɛ de brɛ mo. Mewɔ anidasoɔ sɛ, mobɛte biribiara a

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: monnte aseɛ yie no ase daakye sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, da a Awurade Yesu bɛba no, mode yɛn bɛhoahoa mo ho na yɛn nso yɛde mo ahoahoa yɛn ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Na menim sɛ saa asɛm yi bɛba mu. Ɛno enti na mehyehyɛɛ sɛ mɛba abɛsra mo na moanya nhyira mprenu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ, sɛ merekɔ Makedonia a, mɛba mo nkyɛn, na meresane nso a, mafa mo nkyɛn ansa na makɔ Yudea.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Modwene sɛ mantumi ansi mʼadwene pi wɔ deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ anaa? Anaasɛ mete sɛ obi a ɔka sɛ “Aane” anaa “Dabi” sɛdeɛ ɛbɛsɔ afoforɔ ani?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔnokwafoɔ. Enti sɛ meka sɛ yɛn mmuaeɛ yɛ “Aane” ɛberɛ biara a, ɛyɛ “Aane”, ɛnnyɛ “Dabi” da a.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Ɛfiri sɛ, Yesu Kristo, Onyankopɔn Ba no a me Paulo, Silas ne Timoteo kaa ne ho asɛm kyerɛɛ mo no nsesa. Ɔnnka “Aane” ne “Dabi” da. Ɛberɛ biara ɔdi nʼasɛm so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Ɔno mu na Onyankopɔn bɔhyɛ nyinaa awie pɛyɛ. Yei enti, yɛnam Yesu Kristo so ka “Amen” de hyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:4-20

content: Afei, Onyankopɔn no ankasa na ɔma yɛne mo tumi gyina pintinn wɔ Kristo mu. Ɔno na ɔsraa yɛn

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: faa yɛn sɛ ne deɛ, ɛnna ɔde ne Honhom Kronkron no hyɛɛ yɛn akoma mu de sii deɛ ɔwɔ ma yɛn nyinaa so dua.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Mefrɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ mʼadanseɛ. Ɔnim mʼakoma mu. Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mobɛnya kwan agye mo ahome enti na mankɔ Korinto no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Ɛnyɛ yɛn adwene ne sɛ yɛbɛhyɛ mo ama mo agye biribi adi, na mmom, mo ahotɔ enti na yɛne mo yɛ adwuma. Ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnam mo ankasa gyidie so na mobɛgyina pintinn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Me, Paulo a sɛ mewɔ mo nkyɛn a meyɛ mmerɛ na sɛ menni mo nkyɛn nso a me koko yɛ duru ma mo no, me na metu saa fo yi. Mesrɛ me Kristo a ɔyɛ ɔyamyɛfoɔ no din mu sɛ:

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-4

content: Sɛ meba hɔ a, monnhyɛ me mma menkasakasa mo anim. Menim yie sɛ me bo bɛtumi ayɛ duru wɔ nnipa a wɔka sɛ ewiase adwene na yɛde di dwuma no no so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-4

content: Ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ, yɛte ewiase, nanso yɛnnyina wiasesɛm so wɔ yɛn ko mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-4

content: Akodeɛ a yɛde ko no mfiri ewiase. Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn akodeɛ a ano yɛ den a yɛbɛtumi de asɛe atamfoɔ mpampim a wɔabobɔ. Yɛsɛe akyinnyehunu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:1-4

content: Yɛsɛe akwansideɛ biara a ɛtia Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ no. Yɛto adwene biara nnareka ma wɔtie Kristo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Sɛ mo setie wie pɛyɛ na obi sane yɛ asoɔden ɛkwan biara so a, yɛbɛtwe nʼaso.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Sɛdeɛ nneɛma te no ara na mohunu. Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔkari ne ho ka sɛ, ɔyɛ Kristo dea? Onii no nkari ne ho bio nhwɛ ɛfiri sɛ, yɛn nso yɛyɛ Kristo dea sɛdeɛ ɔno nso yɛ ne dea no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Ɛnyɛ me aniwu sɛ aba sɛ mede tumi a Awurade de ama me sɛ memfa nhwɛ mo na monnyini no bɛhoahoa me ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Mempɛ sɛ modwene sɛ mede me nkrataa a matwerɛ mo no rehunahuna mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Obi bɛka sɛ, “Paulo nkrataa mu nsɛm no yɛ ya nanso sɛ ɔba yɛn nkyɛn nso a, ɔyɛ bɔkɔɔ na ne nsɛm nso nka hwee!”

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Ɛsɛ sɛ saa onipa no te ne ho ase sɛ, nsonsonoeɛ biara nna nsɛm a ɛwɔ yɛn nkrataa a yɛtwerɛɛ ɛberɛ a yɛnni mo nkyɛn no, ne deɛ sɛ yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn a, yɛyɛ no mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Ɛyɛ nokorɛ, yɛrentumi mfa yɛn ho ntoto wɔn a wɔfa wɔn ho sɛ wɔn asetena korɔn no ho. Saa nnipa no yɛ nkwaseafoɔ! Wɔnam wɔn ho a wɔde wɔn ho toto wɔn ho wɔn ho no so bu wɔn ho atɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Yɛn deɛ, yɛn ahohoahoa no nntra beaeɛ bi. Yɛn ahohoahoa no nntra dwuma a Onyankopɔn atu yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ a mo mu adwumayɛ ka ho no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Esiane sɛ mowɔ saa tebea no mu enti, yɛbaa mo nkyɛn bɛkaa Asɛmpa a ɛfa Kristo ho no a yɛantra.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Yei enti yɛmmfa adwuma a nkurɔfoɔ ayɛ nhoahoa yɛn ho te sɛ yɛn ara na yɛyɛeɛ. Deɛ yɛrepɛ ne sɛ mo gyidie ase bɛtim na ɛnam so ama yɛatumi ayɛ mo mu adwuma a yɛntra beaeɛ a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Na yɛnam so atumi aka Asɛmpa wɔ aman foforɔ so a yɛremfa adwuma a ɔfoforɔ ayɛ no nhoahoa yɛn ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Atwerɛsɛm no ka sɛ, “Obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhoahoa ne ho no nhoahoa no wɔ adeɛ a Awurade ayɛ mu.”

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnyɛ ka a onipa bɛka ne ho asɛm pa no na ɛma Onyankopɔn gye no to mu, na mmom onipa a Onyankopɔn no ara bɛka ne ho asɛm pa no na ɔgye no to mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 10:5-18

content: Mewɔ anidasoɔ sɛ, sɛ meyɛ nkwaseadeɛ koraa a, mobɛgye me. Mepa mo kyɛw, monyɛ saa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Metwe mo ho ninkunu, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn twe mo ho ninkunu no. Mote sɛ ɔbaabunu a mahyɛ no awadeɛ ho bɔ ama ɔbarima baako pɛ bi a ɔno ne Kristo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mesuro sɛ wɔbɛsɛe mo adwene na mo a mode mo ho nyinaa ama Kristo no, mobɛgyae sɛdeɛ ɔwɔ no nam anifire so daadaa Hawa no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mode anigyeɛ gye obiara a ɔba mo nkyɛn bɛka Yesu foforɔ a ɔnnyɛ deɛ yɛka ne ho asɛm kyerɛ mo no di; mogye honhom bi ne asɛmpa bi a nsonsonoeɛ da ɛno ne Honhom ne Asɛmpa a yɛka kyerɛ mo no ntam no di.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mennye nni sɛ meyɛ “Asomafoɔ” no mu abomfiaa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ebia mʼano ntee deɛ, nanso mʼadwene mu abue. Ɛkwan biara so, yɛama mo ate saa asɛm yi ase.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mebɛkaa Onyankopɔn Asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ mo no, mannye mo hwee. Mebrɛɛ me ho ase sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma mo akrɔn. Bɔne a meyɛeɛ ne sɛ meyɛɛ saa?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ɛberɛ a na mereyɛ mo mu adwuma no, asafo afoforɔ bi na na wɔtua me ka.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ɛberɛ a na mewɔ mo nkyɛn no, sɛ sika ho hia me a, na menha mo. Na anuanom a wɔte Makedonia no de biribiara a ɛho hia me brɛ me. Sɛdeɛ na ɛte mmerɛ a atwam no, saa ara nso na daakye ɛbɛyɛ. Merenyɛ adesoa mma mo da.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Kristo nokorɛdie a ahyɛ me ma enti, mehyɛ mo bɔ sɛ obiara rentumi nka mʼahohoahoa yi nhyɛ wɔ Helaman mu da.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Adɛn enti na meka saa? Ɛfiri sɛ, mennɔ mo anaa? Onyankopɔn nim sɛ medɔ mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mɛkɔ so madi dwuma a meredi no seesei yi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, saa “asomafoɔ” no rennya kwan nhoahoa wɔn ho sɛ dwuma a wɔdi no te sɛ yɛn dwuma a yɛdi no pɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Saa nnipa no nyɛ nokorɛ asomafoɔ. Wɔyɛ atorɔ asomafoɔ a wɔnam twa atorɔ wɔ wɔn adwuma ho ma nnipa hunu wɔn sɛ wɔyɛ Kristo asomafoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ɛnyɛ me nwanwa, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbonsam koraa tumi sesa ne ho ma ɔdane yɛ sɛ hann.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Enti ɛnyɛ nwanwa sɛ nʼasomfoɔ tumi sesa wɔn ho de daadaa nnipa sɛ wɔyɛ papa. Awieeɛ no, wɔbɛnya wɔn nneyɛeɛ so akatua pɛpɛɛpɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Meti mu ka bio sɛ: Ɛnsɛ sɛ obiara susu sɛ meyɛ ɔkwasea. Sɛ mosusu saa a, ɛnneɛ monnye me sɛdeɛ mobɛgye ɔkwasea na menam so matumi mahoahoa me ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Asɛm a mereka yi nyɛ deɛ Awurade pɛ sɛ meka. Meka ahohoahoa ho asɛm a, na mekasa sɛ ɔkwasea.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Nanso, ɛsiane sɛ nnipa bebree hoahoa wɔn ho nipasu mu enti, me nso mɛyɛ saa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mo ankasa mo ani ate enti mode anigyeɛ gye nkwaseafoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mogye obi a ɔhyɛ mo so anaa deɛ ɔnya mo ho biribi anaa deɛ ɔsum mo afidie anaa deɛ ɔmmu mo anaa deɛ ɔbɔ mo ani so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content:
Mefɛre sɛ mɛgye yei ato mu, nanso yɛn ahoɔmmerɛ na ɛma yɛyɛɛ saa.
    Sɛ obi tumi de biribi hoahoa ne ho a, merekasa sɛ ɔkwasea, e nso mɛtumi ahoahoa me ho wɔ dekodeɛ no ho bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Wɔyɛ Hebrifoɔ anaa? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Israelfoɔ anaa? Me nso meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Abraham asefoɔ anaa? Me nso meyɛ bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Wɔyɛ Kristo asomfoɔ anaa? Merekasa sɛ ɔbɔdamfoɔ. Nanso, meyɛ ɔsomfoɔ pa sene wɔn. Mayɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ den sene wɔn; mada afiase mpɛn bebree; wɔabɔ me mmaa bebree na metaa mebɛn owuo nso.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Yudafoɔ bɔɔ me mmaa aduasa nkron ahodoɔ enum.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Romafoɔ bɔɔ me mmaa mprɛnsa na wɔsii me aboɔ pɛnkorɔ. Metenaa ahyɛn mu maa ɛbɔeɛ mprɛnsa. Medii nsuo ase nnɔnhwere aduonu ɛnan pɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mʼakwantuo ahodoɔ mu, mehyiaa nsuyire ne akwanmukafoɔ. Mehunuu amane wɔ Yudafoɔ ne amanamanmufoɔ nsam. Mehunuu nkuro so amane. Mehunuu wiram amane. Mehunuu ɛpo so amane ne nnamfoɔ a wɔnka nokorɛ nsam amane.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Mayɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ den na ɔbrɛ wɔ mu. Mpɛn pii, menna. Ɛkɔm ne sukɔm dee me. Mpɛn pii, mennya aduane a ɛbɛso me nni. Mennya baabi nna anaa atadeɛ nhyɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ɛberɛ biara na mema asafo ahodoɔ no ho nsɛm yɛ me asɛnhia.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Sɛ obi yɛ mmerɛ a ɛma me nso meyɛ mmerɛ. Sɛ obi ka ɔfoforɔ kɔ bɔne mu a, ɛma me werɛ ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Sɛ mehoahoa me ho a, na ɛsɛ sɛ mehoahoa me ho wɔ nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ me mmerɛyɛ no mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Awurade Yesu no, Onyankopɔn ne Agya no a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkamfo no no nim sɛ merentwa nkontompo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ɛberɛ a mewɔ Damasko no, Amrado a na ɔhyɛ Ɔhene Areta ase no maa awɛmfoɔ wɛnee kuro no ɛpono pɛɛ sɛ wɔkyere me.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Nanso, wɔde me sii kɛntɛn mu twetwee me faa ɔfasuo bi a apae tokuro mu de me sii fam maa medwane firii ne nsam.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 11

content: Ɛwom sɛ ahohoahoa ho nni mfasoɔ biara deɛ, nanso ɛsɛ sɛ mehoahoa me ho. Nanso, afei mɛka anisoadehunu ne adiyisɛm a Awurade ada no adi akyerɛ me no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Menim Okristoni bi a mfeɛ dunan nie, biribi hwimm no de no kɔɔ ɔsoro. Mennim sɛ saa asɛm yi sii ampa ara anaasɛ ɛyɛ anisoadehunu. Onyankopɔn nko ara na ɔnim.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Meti mu bio. Menim sɛ wɔhwimm saa ɔbarima yi kɔɔ Paradise. Bio mennim sɛ saa asɛm yi sii ampa ara anaasɛ ɛyɛ anisoadehunu. Onyankopɔn nko ara na ɔnim.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Na ɛhɔ na ɔtee nneɛma bi a wɔde ka nsɛm a ɛnyɛ yie, nneɛma a onipa anofafa ntumi nka.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Enti, mede saa onipa yi bɛhoahoa me ho na meremfa me ara me ho nhoahoa me ho gye sɛ nneɛma a ɛda me adi sɛ meyɛ mmerɛ no ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Sɛ mehoahoa me ho mpo a, anka merenyɛ ɔkwasea, ɛfiri sɛ, nokorɛ ara na meka. Nanso, merenhoahoa me ho, ɛfiri sɛ, mempɛ sɛ obiara bu me otitire sene sɛdeɛ wahunu na wate afiri me nkyɛn no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛnam saa adiyisɛm nwanwaso yi enti meremma me ho so no, wɔsomaa ɔbonsam ɔbɔfoɔ ma ɔde honam mu yea a emu yɛ den brɛɛ me de brɛɛ me ase.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Mebɔɔ yei ho mpaeɛ mprɛnsa kyerɛɛ Awurade na mesrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmma ɛmfiri me so nkɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Ne mmuaeɛ a ɔmaa me ne sɛ, “Mʼadom nko ara na ɛho hia wo, na ɛberɛ a woayɛ mmerɛ no na me tumi mu yɛ den pa ara.” Enti, ɛyɛ me anigye pa ara sɛ mede me mmerɛyɛ hoahoa me ho, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mɛte Kristo banbɔ tumi a ɛbɔ me ho ban no nka.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Esiane Kristo enti, mepene mmerɛyɛ, ɔyea, amanehunu, ɔtaa ne akwansideɛ so. Ɛfiri sɛ, me mmerɛyɛ mu no na meyɛ den.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Meyɛ me ho sɛ ɔkwasea, nanso mo na moama mayɛ saa. Mo na anka ɛsɛ sɛ mogye me tom. Na sɛ menyɛ hwee a, ɛkwan biara so no, mennyɛ sɛ abomfiaa wɔ mo anim nsene “Asomafoɔ” a mobu wɔn no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Mede boasetɔ dii dwuma wɔ mo mu de kyerɛɛ sɛ meyɛ ɔsomafoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Dwumadie no bi yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ. Adɛn enti na moyɛ asɔre a aka no mu abomfiaa, ɛfiri sɛ, mammisa mo mmoa bi nti? Mesrɛ mo momfa saa mfomsoɔ no nkyɛ me.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Yei ne ne mprɛnsa so a masiesie me ho pɛ sɛ mebɛsra mo. Na meba nso a, meremmisa mo biribiara. Mo na merehwehwɛ mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Ɛbɛyɛ me anigye sɛ mo enti, mɛhwere deɛ mewɔ ne mʼadagyeɛ de aboa mo. Esiane sɛ medɔ mo yie no enti, mo dɔ a modɔ me no so bɛte anaa?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Mobɛte aseɛ sɛ na mennyɛ adesoa mma mo. Nanso, obi bɛka sɛ, meyɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ a mede nnaadaa yii mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Ɛkwan bɛn so? Menam abɔfoɔ a mesomaa wɔn mo nkyɛn no so sisii mo anaa?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Mesomaa Tito sɛ ɔnkɔ, ɛnna mesomaa onua baako kaa ne ho. Mokyerɛ sɛ Tito sisii mo anaa? Ɔno ne me nyinaa kura adwene korɔ nni dwuma korɔ?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Ebia, modwene sɛ pɛ ara na yɛpɛ sɛ yɛka biribi de tete yɛn ho wɔ mo anim. Dabi! Yɛkasa sɛdeɛ Kristo pɛ sɛ yɛka wɔ Onyankopɔn anim. Na biribiara a yɛyɛ no nso, me nnamfo pa, yɛyɛ de boa mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Mesuro sɛ, sɛ meduru hɔ a, sɛdeɛ anka mepɛ sɛ mehunu mo no, merenhunu mo saa. Saa ara nso na sɛdeɛ anka mopɛ sɛ mohunu me no, morenhunu me saa. Menim sɛ mɛba abɛto akasakasa ne anibereɛ, abufuo ne pɛsɛmenkomenya, ɔyea ne nsekuro, ahantan ne basabasayɛ no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Mesuro sɛ da a mɛba bio no, Onyankopɔn bɛgu mʼanim ase wɔ mo anim na mɛsu ama wɔn a wɔayɛ bɔne dada na wɔnnuu wɔn ho wɔ wɔn akɔnnɔ ne adwamammɔ ho no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 12

content: Nsra a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a merebɛsra mo ni. Atwerɛsɛm no ka sɛ, “Adanseɛ a nnipa baanu anaa baasa bɛdi no na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔfa.”

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Ɛberɛ a mebaa mo nkyɛn deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu no, mebɔɔ mo kɔkɔ bi. Mereti mu bio seesei a menni mo nkyɛn yi. Sɛ mesane ba bio a, mo anaa nnipa afoforɔ bi a wɔayɛ bɔne no, meremfa wɔn ho nkyɛ wɔn,

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: ɛfiri sɛ, mopɛ sɛ mohunu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi sɛ Kristo nam me so kasa. Ɔnnyɛ mmerɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mo mu adwuma, na mmom, ɔwɔ tumi wɔ mo mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Ɛwom sɛ mmerɛyɛ mu na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu, nanso Onyankopɔn tumi mu na ɔte ase yi. Yɛyɛ mmerɛ deɛ, nanso yɛn ayɔnkofa a yɛne no wɔ enti, yɛne no bɛtena wɔ Onyankopɔn tumi mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Monsɔ mo ho nhwɛ na mommu mo ho atɛn nhwɛ sɛ mote ase wɔ gyidie mu anaa. Monim yie sɛ Kristo Yesu te mo mu anaa? Sɛ ɔnte mo mu a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ moantumi sɔhwɛ no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Menim yie sɛ mobɛhunu sɛ yɛanni nkoguo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Afei, yɛbɔ mpaeɛ srɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ morennyɛ biribiara a ɛnnyɛ. Yɛmmpɛ sɛ nnipa bɛhunu sɛ yɛwɔ tumi bi wɔ mo so. Sɛ mpo sɛ wɔhunu yɛn sɛ yɛsɛ nnipa a yɛadi nkoguo wɔ yɛn adwuma mu a, yɛpɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, yɛpɛ sɛ mobɛyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ de adi nkonim.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Yɛrentumi nsɔre ntia nokorɛ, na mmom, nokorɛ nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛgyina ma no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Sɛ yɛhunu sɛ yɛyɛ mmerɛ na moyɛ den a, na yɛn ani agye. Enti, yɛn nso yɛrebɔ mpaeɛ sɛ mobɛyɛ pɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Ɛno enti na meretwerɛ saa krataa yi abrɛ mo sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, sɛ meba a, merennyina tumi a Awurade de ama me sɛ memfa mmoa mo na monnyini na mo mu antete no so, na me ne mo anni no anibereɛ so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Enti, anuanom, makra mo! Mompere nhwehwɛ ade pa; montie mʼafotuo; mo ne mo ho mo ho nka na montena ase asomdwoeɛ mu. Na ɔdɔ ne asomdwoeɛ Onyankopɔn no ne mo bɛtena.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Momfa onuadɔ nkyeakyea mo ho mo ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa kyeakyea mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne Onyankopɔn dɔ ne Honhom Kronkron no ayɔnkofa nka mo nyinaa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 13

content: Enti, meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ meremma mo nkyɛn bio mmɛhyɛ mo awerɛhoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Sɛ mebɛhyɛ mo awerɛhoɔ a, hwan na ɔbɛkyekyere me werɛ? Me ara a mahyɛ mo awerɛhoɔ no anaa?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Saa enti na metwerɛɛ saa krataa no brɛɛ mo. Na mempɛ sɛ meba mo nnipa korɔ no ara a mobɛgye mʼani no nkyɛn bɛhyɛ mo awerɛhoɔ. Menim yie sɛ, sɛ me ho tɔ me a, mo nso mo ho bɛtɔ mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Mede amanehunu, awerɛhoɔ ne nisuo na ɛretwerɛ mo saa krataa yi. Mantwerɛ mammɛhyɛ mo awerɛhoɔ na mmom, metwerɛ de bɛkyerɛɛ ɔdɔ a medɔ mo nyinaa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Sɛ obi ahyɛ afoforɔ awerɛhoɔ a, ɛnyɛ me na wahyɛ me saa awerɛhoɔ no, na mo anaasɛ mo mu bi na wahyɛ no saa awerɛhoɔ no. Mempɛ sɛ me nsa yɛ den wɔ saa onipa no so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Asotwe a dodoɔ no ara atwe no no dɔɔso ma no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Ɛsɛ sɛ mode kyɛ no na mokyekyere ne werɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a awerɛhoɔ renhyɛ ne so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Mesrɛ mo, momma ɔnhunu sɛ mopɛ nʼasɛm pa ara.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Deɛ enti a metwerɛ mo krataa no ne sɛ: Mepɛ sɛ mehunu sɛ moatumi agyina sɔhwɛ no ano pintinn na nsɛm a meka kyerɛ mo no nso, modi so anaa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne bi na mode kyɛ no a, me nso mede kyɛ no. Sɛ ɛho hia sɛ mede kyɛ na mede kyɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ mede biribiara kyɛ. Na mo enti na meyɛ saa wɔ Kristo anim

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔbonsam rennya yɛn ho ɛkwan, ɛfiri sɛ, yɛnim ne nsusuiɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Ɛberɛ a meduruu Troa kɔkaa Asɛmpa no, mehunuu sɛ Awurade ama adwuma no yɛ ho ɛkwan wɔ hɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Nanso, me werɛ hoeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, na menhunu yɛn nua Tito. Enti, mekraa nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ no na mesiim mekɔɔ Makedonia.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 1:21-2:13

content: Yɛda Onyankopɔn ase sɛ daa ɔto yɛn santene wɔ anigyeɛ ne nkonimdie wɔ Kristo mu ma yɛyi hwa a ɛyɛ hwam. Onyankopɔn nam yɛn so ma Kristo ho asɛm trɛ kɔ baabiara sɛ aduhwam.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Yɛte sɛ aduhwam a Kristo de ama Onyankopɔn a ɛtrɛ kɔ wɔn a wɔregye wɔn nkwa ne wɔn a wɔreyera mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Na wɔn a wɔreyera no deɛ, ɛyɛ wɔn hwa bɔne a ɛtumi kum. Nanso, wɔn a wɔregye wɔn nkwa no, ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ hwam a ɛma wɔn nkwa. Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina adwuma a ɛyɛ den sei anim?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Yɛnte sɛ nnipa afoforɔ bi a wɔfa Onyankopɔn asɛm sɛ adetɔndeɛ bi, na ɛsiane sɛ Onyankopɔn asoma yɛn no enti, yɛka nokorɛ wɔ nʼanim sɛ Kristo asomfoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Yei kyerɛ sɛ yɛrehoahoa yɛn ho bio anaa? Anaasɛ yɛhia adansedie nkrataa a ɛfiri yɛn nkyɛn anaa mo nkyɛn sɛdeɛ afoforɔ hia no anaa?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Mo ankasa moyɛ krataa a ɛwɔ yɛn nkyɛn a wɔatwerɛ wɔ yɛn akoma mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a obiara bɛhunu na wakan.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Mote sɛ krataa a Kristo nam yɛn som so atwerɛ. Ɛnyɛ twerɛduro na wɔde twerɛɛ no ɛboɔ ɛpono so, na mmom Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase no Honhom na wɔde twerɛ guu nnipa akoma mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Saa ahotosoɔ yi na yɛnam Kristo so anya wɔ Onyankopɔn fam.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Biribiara nni yɛn mu a ɛbɛtumi ama yɛasi yɛn bo aka sɛ yɛbɛtumi ayɛ saa adwuma yi. Ahoɔden a yɛwɔ no firi Onyankopɔn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Ɔno na wama yɛn afata sɛ NʼApam Foforɔ ho asomfoɔ. Ɛfiri Honhom Kronkron no na ɛmfiri mmara a wɔatwerɛ. Mmara de owuo ba na Honhom no deɛ ɛma nkwa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Mmara a ɛde owuo baeɛ no, na wɔatwerɛ no ɛboɔ ɛpono so, nanso animuonyam a na ɛkura no enti nnipa no antumi anhwɛ Mose anim. Mose animuonyam hyerɛneeɛ nanso saa animuonyam no dumiiɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Enti, apam a Honhom no de ba no, ɛrennya animuonyam mmorosoɔ anaa?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Sɛ mmara a ɛde owuo ba no wɔ animuonyam a, ɛnneɛ deɛ ɛma yɛtene Onyankopɔn anim no rennya animuonyam a ɛboro so?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Nokorɛm, Apam Foforɔ no animuonyam mmorosoɔ enti, mmara a ɛde owuo ba no animuonyam ayera.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Na sɛ na animuonyam wɔ biribi a ɛnkyɛre mu a, animuonyam bɛn na ade a ɛte hɔ daa no rennya.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Esiane sɛ yɛwɔ saa anidasoɔ yi enti, yɛwɔ akokoɔduru.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Yɛnte sɛ Mose a ɔde nkatanimu kataa nʼanim sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Israelfoɔ no renhunu nʼanim hyerɛn no pa a ɛrepa na ayera no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Nanso nteaseɛ a wɔn annya no enti ɛbɛsi ɛnnɛ yi, sɛ wɔkenkan Apam Dada nwoma no a, saa nkatanimu no da so kata wɔn adwene so. Ansa na nkatanimu no bɛfiri hɔ no, gye sɛ ɔgye Kristo di.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 2:14-3:14

content: Ɛbɛsi ɛnnɛ, ɛberɛ biara a wɔbɛkenkan Mose mmara no, nkatanimu no da so kata wɔn adwene so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 3:15-23

content: Nanso sɛ obi gye Awurade di a, ne nkatanimu no, woyi firi hɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 3:15-23

content: Na Awurade ne Honhom no, na baabiara a Awurade Honhom wɔ no, ahotɔ wɔ hɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 3:15-23

content: Yɛn a nkatanimu biara nkata yɛn anim no, Awurade animuonyam hyerɛn yɛn anim, na Awurade Honhom no sakra yɛn kɔ nʼanimuonyam mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 3:15-23

content: Onyankopɔn nam nʼadom so de saa asɛm yi abrɛ yɛn na ɛno enti, ɛmma yɛn akoma ntu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-6

content: Yɛagyae kokoamsɛm ne aniwudeyɛ nyinaa. Yɛnnaadaa na yɛntwa Onyankopɔn asɛm no ho nkontompo. Yɛnnaadaa obi mma ɔnnye deɛ Atwerɛsɛm no nkaeɛ nni. Yɛgyae saa aniwudeɛ no nyinaa. Yɛgyina Onyankopɔn anim kasa enti yɛka nokorɛ ma wɔn a wɔnim yɛn no nyinaa gye di.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-6

content: Sɛ Asɛmpa a yɛka no yɛ ahintasɛm a, ɛyɛ ahintasɛm ma wɔn a wɔreyera.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-6

content: Wɔnnye nni, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbonsam asɛe wɔn adwene. Ɔtwe wɔn firi hann a ɛto gu wɔn so no ho; hann a ɛfiri Asɛmpa no mu a ɛfa Kristo a ɔte sɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam no ho no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-6

content: Ɛnyɛ yɛn ankasa ho na yɛka asɛm no fa. Yɛka Yesu Kristo ho asɛm sɛ ɔno ne Awurade no na yɛn nso Yesu enti, yɛyɛ mo asomfoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-6

content: Onyankopɔn a ɔkaa sɛ, “Hann mfiri esum mu nhyerɛn no” ɔno na wahyerɛn wɔ yɛn akoma mu, ama yɛanya Onyankopɔn animuonyam ho nimdeɛ wɔ Yesu Kristo mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:1-6

content: Yɛte sɛ nkukuo a wɔde agyapadeɛ asie mu. Tumi ankasa no firi Onyankopɔn na ɛmfiri yɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Yɛtaa hunu amane, nanso wɔnnsɛee yɛn. Mpo sɛ yɛnnim deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ a yɛmpa aba.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Amaneɛ mu, Onyankopɔn ka yɛn ho, na sɛ wɔbɔ yɛn hwe fam a yɛsɔre bio.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Mmerɛ nyinaa yɛn onipadua no soa Yesu wu a ɔwuiɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nʼabrabɔ bɛda adi wɔ yɛn mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Yɛn asetena mu nyinaa, Yesu enti, yɛte hɔ ma owuo sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, nʼabrabɔ bɛda adi wɔ yɛn onipadua a ɛwu no mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Yei kyerɛ sɛ owuo di ne dwuma wɔ yɛn mu ɛnna nkwa nso di ne dwuma wɔ mo mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Atwerɛsɛm no ka sɛ, “Mekasaeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, na megye di.” Saa honhom mu gyidie no ara so na ɛma yɛn nso yɛkasa, ɛfiri sɛ, yɛgye di.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Yɛnim sɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔmaa Awurade Yesu sɔre firii awufoɔ mu no bɛma yɛne Yesu asɔre na ɔde yɛn abɛka mo ho wɔ nʼanim.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Mo enti na yeinom bɛba mu; na sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn adom no reduru nnipa bebree nkyɛn no, saa ara nso na wɔbɛbɔ mpaeɛ ada Onyankopɔn ase de ahyɛ no animuonyam.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Esiane yei enti, yɛn bo ntu. Ɛwom sɛ yɛn onipadua no reporɔ nkakrankakra deɛ, nanso yɛn honhom no deɛ, ɛsesa yɛ foforɔ da biara da.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Na saa ɔhaw kakra a yɛfa mu no de animuonyam a ɛnni awieeɛ a ɛboro saa ɔhaw no so no bɛbrɛ yɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Yɛmfa yɛn adwene nkɔ nneɛma a yɛhunu so, na mmom, nneɛma a yɛnhunu so na yɛde yɛn adwene kɔ. Deɛ wɔtumi hunu no ntena hɔ nkyɛ, nanso deɛ yɛntumi nhunu no tena hɔ daa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 4:7-18

content: Yɛnim sɛ, sɛ yɛwu na yɛgya saa onipadua yi a, yɛbɛnya onipadua foforɔ a Onyankopɔn ankasa ayɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa wɔ ɔsoro hɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Seesei, yɛsi apinie pɛ sɛ wɔde ɔsoro animuonyam foforɔ no kata yɛn ho,

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ wɔde kata yɛn ho a, yɛn ho renna hɔ bio.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Na sɛ yɛwɔ saa honam yi mu a, yɛsi apinie na adesoa bi da yɛn so; ɛnyɛ sɛ yɛmmpɛ sɛ yɛgya onipadua no, na mmom, yɛpɛ sɛ wɔde ɔsoro atenaeɛ foforɔ no kata yɛn ho sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, nkwa bɛmene deɛ ɛwu no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Onyankopɔn na wasiesie yɛn ama saa nsakraeɛ yi. Na ɔde ne Honhom no maa yɛn sɛ deɛ ɔwɔ ma yɛn no nyinaa akyigyina.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Yei enti, daa yɛwɔ akokoɔduru. Yɛnim sɛ mmerɛ dodoɔ a yɛwɔ saa onipadua yi mu no, ɛma yɛne Awurade fie kwan ware.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Ɛfiri sɛ, yɛn nkwa gyina gyidie so na ɛnnyina deɛ yɛhunu so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Yɛwɔ nkuranhyɛ enti, ɛyɛ yɛn pɛ sɛ yɛbɛtu afiri yɛn fie wɔ saa honam yi mu na yɛne Awurade akɔtena ne fie.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Sɛ yɛwɔ yɛn fie ha anaa nohoa no, yɛpɛ sɛ yɛsɔ nʼani sene biribiara.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Ɛfiri sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn nyinaa ba Kristo anim ma ɔbu yɛn atɛn. Sɛdeɛ obiara tenaa ase wɔ onipadua no abrabɔ mu no, sɛ ɛyɛ papa anaa bɔne na wɔbɛgyina so abu no atɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:1-10

content: Ɛfiri sɛ yɛnim sɛdeɛ yɛsuro Awurade enti, yɛka ne ho asɛmpa kyerɛ nnipa. Onyankopɔn nim yɛn yie na mewɔ anidasoɔ sɛ monim me nso wɔ mo akoma mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:11-16

content: Yɛrensane nka yɛn ho asɛmpa nkyerɛ mo, na mmom, yɛrebɔ ho mmɔden sɛdeɛ mode yɛn bɛhoahoa mo ho na moatumi abua wɔn a wɔde onipa anim hoahoa wɔn ho na ɛnyɛ wɔn su no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:11-16

content: Sɛ yɛabobɔ adam a ɛyɛ yɛne Onyankopɔn ntam asɛm. Nanso sɛ yɛn adwene mu da hɔ a, ɛyɛ ma mo yiedie.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:11-16

content: Afei a yɛahunu sɛ onipa baako na ɔwu maa nnipa nyinaa wuu bi no enti, Kristo dɔ a ɔde dɔ yɛn no na ɛhyɛ yɛn. Yei kyerɛ sɛ nnipa nyinaa wɔ ne wuo no mu kyɛfa bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:11-16

content: Ɔwu maa yɛn nyinaa, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wɔte ase no rentena ase mma wɔn ho bio na mmom, wɔbɛtena ase ama deɛ yɛn enti, ɔwuiɛ a wɔmaa ɔsɔre firii awufoɔ mu no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:11-16

content: Enti, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛgyina onipa adwene so bu obiara atɛn bio. Na sɛ mpo ɛberɛ bi a atwam no na yɛgyina nnipa adwene so na yɛhunu Kristo a, afei deɛ, yɛrenyɛ saa bio.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:11-16

content: Sɛ obi wɔ Kristo mu a, na ɔyɛ abɔdeɛ foforɔ, na nneɛma dada nyinaa atwam ama nneɛma foforɔ aba.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:17-21

content: Onyankopɔn ayɛ ne nyinaa. Ɔsomaa Kristo sɛ ɔmmɛpata ɔne yɛn ntam na ɔde ɔne afoforɔ ntam mpata dwumadie no ahyɛ yɛn nsa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:17-21

content: Asɛm a wɔde abrɛ yɛn ne sɛ, Onyankopɔn nam Kristo so afa nnipa nyinaa adamfo. Onyankopɔn ankan wɔn bɔne antia wɔn na ɔde nʼasomdwoeɛ asɛnka ho dwumadie no ahyɛ yɛn nsa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:17-21

content: Enti yɛyɛ asomafoɔ ma Kristo, na ɛte sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn nam yɛn so kasa kyerɛ mo. Yesi Kristo anan mu srɛ mo sɛ, momma wɔmfa mo mmata Onyankopɔn ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:17-21

content: Na Kristo nni bɔne, nanso yɛn enti, Onyankopɔn maa ɔfaa yɛn bɔne sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, yɛnam ɔno Kristo so bɛyɛ teneneefoɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 5:17-21

content: Anuanom a yɛne Onyankopɔn bom yɛ adwuma, yɛsrɛ mo sɛ, Onyankopɔn adom a mo nsa aka no, monnnye no kwa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content:
Onyankopɔn se,
  “Ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu no, mɛbua wo,
    na nkwagyeɛ da no, mɛboa wo.”
Montie! Dɔnhwere yi mu na ɛsɛ sɛ monya Onyankopɔn adom, na ɛnnɛ ne nkwagyeɛ da no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Yɛmmpɛ sɛ obiara bɛnya yɛn adwuma ho asɛm bɔne aka enti yɛmmpɛ sɛ yɛde suntidua to obiara kwan mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Biribiara a yɛbɛyɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛda yɛn ho adi sɛ Onyankopɔn nkoa na yɛde boasetɔ tumi gyina ɔhaw ne amaneɛ nyinaa ano.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Wɔahwe yɛn, wɔde yɛn ato afiase, ɛdɔm baa yɛn so, wɔama yɛayɛ adwuma a ɛboro yɛn so, yɛasi pɛ, akyene kɔm.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Nanso, yɛnam yɛn kronnyɛ, osuahunu, boasetɔ ne ayamyɛ so ada yɛn ho adi sɛ yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn asomfoɔ. Afei, yɛnam Honhom Kronkron no so, yɛn nokorɛ dɔ,

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: yɛn nokwasɛm a yɛka ne Onyankopɔn tumi so kyerɛ sɛ yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn asomfoɔ. Tenenee ne yɛn akokyɛm a yɛde kɔ ɔtamfoɔ so na yɛde bɔ yɛn ho ban nso.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Sɛ wɔhoahoa yɛn o, sɛ wɔgu yɛn anim ase o, sɛ wɔya yɛn o, sɛ wɔkamfo yɛn o, yɛkɔ so ara som Onyankopɔn. Wɔbu yɛn sɛ atorofoɔ nanso yɛka nokorɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛdeɛ wɔnnim yɛn nanso obiara nim yɛn. Yɛwuiɛ, sɛdeɛ mohunu no, nanso yɛte ase. Ɛwom sɛ wɔtwee yɛn aso nanso wɔankum yɛn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Wɔmaa yɛn werɛ hoeɛ nanso yɛn ani gye daa. Yɛsɛ ahiafoɔ nanso yɛma nnipa bebree nya wɔn ho. Asɛ yɛn nsam nni hwee, nanso yɛwɔ biribiara.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:1-10

content: Me nnamfonom a mowɔ Korinto, yɛabue yɛn akoma mu aka nokorɛ akyerɛ mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content: Yɛmfaa biribiara nsiee mo wɔ yɛn akoma mu na mo na mode nsɛm asie yɛn wɔ mo akoma mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content: Seesei, mekasa mekyerɛ mo sɛ me mma: sɛdeɛ yɛdwene mo ho no, mo nso monnwene yɛn ho saa ara bi. Mommfa biribiara nsie yɛn. Mommue mo akoma mu!

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content: Monnyaa mo ho mma abosonsomfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, moyɛ no saa a, ɛnyɛ yie. Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na deɛ ɛyɛ ne deɛ ɛnyɛ ahyia? Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na hann ne sum atena faako?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Kristo ne ɔbonsam adwene ahyia? Ɛdeɛn na ogyidini ne deɛ ɔnyɛ ogyidini wɔ yɛ?

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content:
Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Onyankopɔn asɔredan ne ɔbonsam ahoni ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ? Yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔte ase no asɔredan sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn no ankasa aka sɛ,
  “Mede me nkurɔfoɔ bɛyɛ me fie
    na matena wɔn mu;
  mɛyɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn
    na wɔayɛ me nkurɔfoɔ.”

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content:
Ɛno enti,
  “Monkɔ. Momfiri hɔ nkɔ
    mommfa mo ho nka biribiara a ɛho nteɛ.
    Awurade na ɔseɛ.
  Monte mo ho mfiri deɛ ɛho nte ho,
    na mɛgye mo.”

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content:
Na,
  “Mɛyɛ mo Agya,
    na mobɛyɛ me mmammarima ne me mmammaa.”
    Otumfoɔ Awurade na ɔseɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 6:11-18

content: Me nnamfo pa, wɔahyɛ yɛn saa bɔ yi nyinaa. Enti, momma yɛnte yɛn ho mfiri biribiara a ɛgu honam anaa ɔkra no ho fi ho na yɛntena ase Onyankopɔn mu mfa nte yɛn ho kronn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Mommue mo akoma mu mma yɛn. Yɛnyɛɛ obiara bɔne. Yɛnsisii obiara na yɛmmuu obiara kwasea nso.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Merenka saa asɛm yi mfa ngu mo anim ase. Sɛdeɛ madi ɛkan aka no, yɛdɔ mo enti, daa sɛ yɛwu o, yɛte ase o, mowɔ yɛn akoma mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Megye mo di enti mede mo hoahoa me ho. Yɛn haw nyinaa mu no, mempaa aba. Mede ahosɛpɛ retu mmirika no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Mpo yɛduruu Makedonia no, yɛanhome. Na ɔhaw wɔ hɔ baabiara. Na akasakasa wɔ wɔn ntam. Afei, na ehu wɔ yɛn akoma mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Onyankopɔn a ɔhyɛ wɔn a wɔpa aba den no nam Tito ba a ɔbaeɛ no so hyɛɛ yɛn den.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Ɛnyɛ ne ba a ɔbaeɛ no nko, na mmom, ka a ɔbɛkaa sɛ mohyɛɛ no nkuran no. Ɔkaa sɛdeɛ mopɛ sɛ mohunu me no kyerɛɛ me. Ɔkaa sɛdeɛ modii yea ne sɛdeɛ na moasiesie mo ho sɛ mobɛbɔ me ho ban no enti seesei, ama mʼani agye sene kane no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Sɛ me krataa a metwerɛɛ mo no hyɛɛ mo awerɛhoɔ a, ɛnyɛ me ya sɛ metwerɛeɛ. Ahyɛaseɛ no ɛhaa me nanso seesei deɛ ɛnha me. Menim sɛ krataa no mu nsɛm hoo mo werɛ ɛberɛ tiawa bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Nanso, seesei deɛ, mʼani agye, ɛnyɛ sɛ memaa mo werɛ hoeɛ no enti, na mmom, sɛ mo awerɛhoɔ no ama moasesa mo akwan. Onyankopɔn na ɔmaa mo werɛ hoeɛ enti yɛn deɛ, yɛanha mo.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Awerɛhoɔ a Onyankopɔn de baa mo so no enti, moanya ahonuo bi a ɛnam so de mo bɛkɔ nkwagyeɛ mu; enti ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mo ya. Nanso, awerɛhoɔ a ewiase de brɛ yɛn no deɛ, ɛde owuo na ɛba.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Monhwɛ deɛ Onyankopɔn nam ho a ɔmaa mo werɛ hooɛ so ayɛ. Mopɛ sɛ mofiri mo akoma mu kyerɛ sɛ monni fɔ. Mo bo afu. Mo ho adwiri mo. Mo ho pere mo, pɛ sɛ mohunu sɛ atɛntenenee ayɛ adwuma. Moakyerɛ sɛ modi bem wɔ asɛm yi ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Ɛwom sɛ metwerɛɛ saa krataa no deɛ, nanso ɛnyɛ obi a ɔyɛ bɔne anaa obi a wɔyɛ no bɔne enti na metwerɛeɛ. Metwerɛ bɛkyerɛɛ mo mu sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn anim, mode mo ho nyinaa ama yɛn no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content:
Ɛno na ɛhyɛ yɛn nkuran no.
    Ɛnyɛ nkuranhyɛ a ɛhyɛɛ yɛn no nko. Tito nso nam gye a mogyee no maa nʼani gyeeɛ no so maa yɛn nso ani gyeeɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Mede mo ahoahoa me ho akyerɛ no na moanni me hwammɔ. Daa yɛka nokorɛ kyerɛ mo na hoa a mede mo hoahoa me ho kyerɛ Tito no nso aba mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Enti, sɛ ɔkae sɛdeɛ mo nyinaa pɛɛ sɛ moyɛ ɔsetie ma no na mode obuo ne anidie gyee no fɛ so no a, ɛma ɔdɔ a ɔdɔ mo no mu den ara na ɛreyɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Ɛyɛ me anigye sɛ mɛtumi de me ho nyinaa ato mo so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 7

content: Anuanom, yɛpɛ sɛ mohunu deɛ Onyankopɔn adom ayɛ wɔ Makedonia asɔre ahodoɔ mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Wɔn ahokyere mu wɔn anigyeɛ boroo so, na wɔn hia mu mpo, woyii ayamyɛ kɛseɛ kyerɛeɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Medi ho adanseɛ sɛ wɔmaa deɛ wɔbɛtumi ma ɛboroo so mpo. Wɔn ara firii wɔn pɛ mu

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: srɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛmma wɔmfa sika no nkɔma Akristofoɔ a wɔwɔ Yudea no bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Wɔyɛ maa ɛboroo so. Deɛ ɛdi ɛkan no, wɔde wɔn ho maa Awurade. Afei, wɔfiri Onyankopɔn pɛ mu de wɔn ho maa yɛn nso.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Enti, yɛka kyerɛɛ Tito a ɔhyɛɛ adwuma yi ase sɛ, ɔntoa so na ɔmmoa mo na moatumi awie saa ɔdɔ adwuma yi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Moyɛ adefoɔ wɔ deɛ mowɔ nyinaa mu: ɔkasa mu ne nimdeɛ mu, mmoa a ɛyɛ mo pɛ sɛ moboa mu, ne ɔdɔ a mode dɔ yɛn mu. Enti, yɛpɛ sɛ mode ahofama som wɔ ɔdɔ mu.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Merenhyehyɛ mmara mma mo. Na mmom, mepɛ sɛ mede mo dɔ a mowɔ no toto afoforɔ deɛ ho hwɛ sɛ mo dɔ no yɛ ɔdɔ pa ara anaa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Monim adom a na yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo wɔ. Ɔdefoɔ a na ɔyɛ no nyinaa akyi, mo enti, ɔyɛɛ ne ho ohiani sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔnam ne hia no so bɛma mo ayɛ adefoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Mʼadwene a mewɔ wɔ asɛm no ho nie: Afe ni, mo na modii ɛkan yɛɛ ayɛ na mofiri mo pɛ mu na momaeɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Monkɔ so na monwie dwuma no di. Momma mo ho mpere mo sɛ mobɛwie sɛdeɛ mosusuiɛ sɛ mobɛyɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Sɛ wo ho pere wo sɛ wobɛma a, Onyankopɔn nam deɛ wowɔ so bɛgye, na ɛnyɛ deɛ wonnie so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Merennye nkurɔfoɔ adesoa mmɛgu mo so na mmom, ɛsiane sɛ mowɔ bebree saa ɛberɛ yi mu no enti, ɛyɛ fɛ sɛ moboa wɔn a wɔnni bi no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Na sɛ ɛba sɛ biribi ho hia mo na sɛ wɔwɔ bi a, wɔaboa mo. Yei ma mo nyinaa yɛ pɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Sɛdeɛ Atwerɛsɛm no ka sɛ, “Wɔn a wɔnyaa pii no, ebi anka, ɛnna wɔn a wɔnyaa kakra bi no nso, ɛsoo wɔn.”

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Yɛda Onyankopɔn ase sɛ wama Tito mo ho anigyeɛ, sɛdeɛ me nso mʼani gye mo ho no bi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔpenee yɛn abisadeɛ so nko, na mmom, ɔno ankasa firii ne pɛ mu pɛɛ sɛ ɔboa enti na ɔsii nʼadwene pi sɛ ɔbɛba mo nkyɛn no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Yɛresoma onua bi a wɔbu no wɔ asɔre ahodoɔ no nyinaa mu wɔ asɛnka no ho no aka ne ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Ɛno akyi, asɔre ahodoɔ no ayi onua yi sɛ ɔne yɛn ntutu akwan wɔ mmerɛ a yɛredi ɔdɔ ho dwuma de ahyɛ Awurade animuonyam yi no, na yɛmfa nkyerɛ nso sɛ yɛpɛ sɛ yɛboa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Yɛhwɛ yɛn ho so yie sɛ asɛm biara remma kwan a yɛbɛfa so de saa akyɛdeɛ yi adi dwuma no ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Yɛn botaeɛ ne sɛ, yɛbɛyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ Awurade ne nnipa anim.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Enti, yɛresoma onipa foforɔ bi aka Tito ne osuani baako no ho. Yɛasɔ no akwan ahodoɔ bebree so ahwɛ na yɛahunu sɛ ɛyɛ ne pɛ sɛ ɔboa. Na seesei ne ho pere no sɛ ɔbɛboa ɛfiri sɛ wanya mo mu ahotosoɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Tito deɛ, ɔyɛ me ɔboafoɔ a ɔne me yɛ adwuma de boa mo na anuanom a wɔne no rekɔ no deɛ, wɔyɛ asɔre ahodoɔ ananmusifoɔ a wɔhyɛ Kristo animuonyam.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Momma wɔnhunu ɔdɔ a modɔ wɔn sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, asafo no nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ hoa a yɛde mo hoahoa yɛn ho no yɛ nokorɛ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 8

content: Ɛho nhia sɛ metwerɛ mo fa mmoa a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔboa Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yudea no ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Menim sɛ ɛyɛ mo pɛ sɛ moboa enti, mede mo ahoahoa me ho akyerɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Makedonia no. Mekaa sɛ, “Anuanom a wɔwɔ Hela no siesiee wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛboa afe a ɛtwaam no mu.” Mo ahokeka no akanyane wɔn mu fa kɛseɛ no.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Afei, merema anuanom yi aba mo nkyɛn sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, hoa a yɛde mo hoahoa yɛn ho no nnyɛ nsɛnkeka kwa. Na, sɛdeɛ mekaeɛ no, mobɛsiesie mo ho aboa.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Sɛ anyɛ saa na sɛ nnipa no ne me firi Makedonia ba bɛhunu sɛ monsiesiee mo ho a, yɛn anim bɛgu ase. Mo nso mo anim bɛgu ase bi sɛ modii yɛn hwammɔ.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Enti, medwene ho hunuu sɛ, ɛyɛ sɛ anuanom bi di mʼanim ɛkan na wɔkɔpɛ akyɛdeɛ a mohyɛɛ me ho bɔ no gu hɔ. Ɛba saa a, ɛberɛ a mɛduru hɔ no na ɛwɔ hɔ na adi adanseɛ sɛ mo na momaeɛ ɛfiri sɛ, na mopɛ sɛ moma enti, na mmom, na ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ moma.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Monkae saa asɛm yi: Onipa a ɔgu aba kakra bi no, bɛtwa so kakraa bi, na deɛ ɔgu aba bebree no, bɛtwa so bebree.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Mo mu biara mma sɛdeɛ wadwene ho no, a ɛnyɛ sɛ yea anaa ɔhyɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ, Onyankopɔn pɛ obi a ɔde anigyeɛ ma akyɛdeɛ no asɛm.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Na Onyankopɔn bɛtumi ama wo aboro deɛ ɛho hia wo no so, enti daa na wowɔ deɛ ɛho hia wo, na wobɛnya bi nso adi dwuma foforɔ a ɛfata sɛ wodi.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9
Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Na Onyankopɔn a ɔma ogufoɔ no aba ne burodo sɛ aduane die no bɛma wo nso aba a ɛhia wo nyinaa na wahwɛ so ama anyini na wʼadɔeɛ no enti, aso bebree.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Daa ɔbɛhwɛ ma woanya wo ho na woayɛ adɔeɛ, na ɛnam so ama dodoɔ no ara ada Onyankopɔn ase wɔ akyɛdeɛ a yɛnya firi mo nkyɛn no ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Saa adɔeɛ a moyɛ yi, monnyɛ mma Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ nko, na mmom, ɛnam so ma nnipa bebree da Onyankopɔn ase.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Esiane dwuma a moadi de adi mo ho adanseɛ pa no enti, nnipa gyina nokorɛ a moadi wɔ Kristo asɛnka no ne mo adɔeɛ a moyɛ maa obiara no so bɛkamfo Onyankopɔn.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Enti, wɔde ɔdɔ bɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo, ɛfiri sɛ, Onyankopɔn ama mo adom a ɛboro so.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9

content: Yɛda Onyankopɔn ase wɔ nʼakyɛdeɛ a ɛnni kabea no ho.

teaching.name: Korintofoɔ Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mienu 9
